parameters.text: ={{ (() => { const items = ($json.items || []).filter(e => e && e.entity_id); if (!items.length) return ''; const esc = s => String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/&/g,'&').replace(//g,'>'); const lines = items.slice(0, 15).map(e => '• ' + esc(e.entity_id) + ' · rule ' + (e.rule_id || '?') + ' · since ' + esc(e.created_at)); const more = items.length > 15 ? ' … +' + (items.length - 15) + ' more' : ''; return '⚠️ Stale Pause Pending (' + items.length + ') ' + lines.join(' ') + more + ' Manual check needed — campaigns flagged for pause but not confirmed via FB API after 10+ min.'; })() }}
